description:
Goal
Regression target for the unified root fz-f98. Enum.reduce/2 and Enum.reduce/3 over a Map must work on interp + run + build.

Symptom (one face of the fz-f98 root)
On a non-empty map %{2 => :two, 1 => :one}:
- Enum.reduce(map, 0, fn ({k, _v}, acc) -> acc + k end) (reduce/3 over Map)
- Enum.reduce(map, fn ({k, _v}, {ak, av}) -> {ak + k, av} end) (reduce/2 over Map)
both panic during native lowering: native attempted to materialize absent value as runtime value with ty Some(Ty(19)) in function 65 (a Map reduce path); native.rs:2826. Interp also reports Enum.EmptyError for reduce/2 over the non-empty map. The same fn65/Ty(19) appears with return_ty: None in the range+map storm telemetry (fz-bfh.4).

Why it is the fz-f98 root: Map's Enumerable.reduce works fine with a NON-capturing reducer (verified); only the captured-callable bridge drops the value. Same decorrelation root, Map-specific surfacing.

Required work (verification; fix is in fz-f98)
- Pin reduce/2 and reduce/3 over Map fixtures on interp + run + build.

Checks
- New Map-reduce regressions green on all three paths.
- map_enumerable remains green.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
title: Enum.reduce/2 and reduce/3 over a Map materialize an absent value (native.rs:2826)
